stem:
Nicole had a collection of 60 stuffed animals. She gave away 5 stuffed animals per month until all her stuffed animals were gone.

Which graph best represents this situation?

options.label: A
options.text: Graph A: Number of stuffed animals starts at 60 and decreases linearly to 0 over 12 months.

options.label: B
options.text: Graph B: Number of stuffed animals starts around 60 and increases to about 120 over 12 months.

options.label: C
options.text: Graph C: Number of stuffed animals starts at 0 and increases drastically to about 780 over 12 months.

options.label: D
options.text: Graph D: Number of stuffed animals starts at about 600 and decreases linearly to 0 over 12 months.
